name: capture.sender
description: Who a sender of the capture account is linked to: the person, their name and the brand they saved to last; none when not linked. With hint, an unlinked sender is marked as told how to link, at most once a day: hint answers whether to tell them now. Internal: packages/connect's webhook, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with s as (select x.user_id, x.name, x.last_brand from brandbase.capture_senders x where x.account = :account and x.sender = :sender and x.user_id is not null), h as (insert into brandbase.capture_senders as x (account, sender, hinted_at) select :account, :sender, :now::timestamptz where :hint::boolean and not exists (select 1 from s) on conflict (account, sender) do update set hinted_at = excluded.hinted_at where x.user_id is null and (x.hinted_at is null or x.hinted_at <= excluded.hinted_at - interval '1 day') returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('userId', (select user_id from s), 'name', (select name from s), 'lastBrand', (select last_brand from s), 'hint', exists (select 1 from h)) as result
